title: Define the selected stack's foundation and assess VPS constraints
delivery: foundation using the user-selected React/TypeScript frontend, Node.js/Express/TypeScript backend, PostgreSQL/Prisma persistence, and Docker/Nginx deployment. Approved supporting tools: Vite, React Router, TanStack Query, Zustand for shared local UI state, React Hook Form/Zod, PostgreSQL-backed Express sessions, Argon2, Helmet/rate limiting, Multer, Pino, Vitest/Supertest/Playwright, and development lint/format tools. Use one repository, an SPA and same-origin REST API, Docker Compose and private attachment delivery; start with existing design tokens/custom CSS. Verify and pin compatible versions; record measured or explicitly unavailable VPS capacity evidence, recovery-cost options, and performance targets for owner approval. No production deployment or infrastructure mutation is implied. Record unknown provider/domain/workloads and budget tradeoff. The user expects to maintain primarily through AI coding tools.
criteria: Record the approved React/TypeScript, Express/TypeScript, PostgreSQL/Prisma and Docker/Nginx foundation and supporting dependency decisions.
Verify mutually compatible stable versions and document exact version pins, service layout and test execution strategy before installation.
Document VPS evidence or unavailable evidence, recovery costs/unknowns, budget tradeoffs and measurable performance targets; obtain owner acceptance of unresolved choices without deploying.
body:
## Parent

https://github.com/aymanobeid0/clinic-app/issues/1

## What to build

foundation using the user-selected React/TypeScript frontend, Node.js/Express/TypeScript backend, PostgreSQL/Prisma persistence, and Docker/Nginx deployment. Approved supporting tools: Vite, React Router, TanStack Query, Zustand for shared local UI state, React Hook Form/Zod, PostgreSQL-backed Express sessions, Argon2, Helmet/rate limiting, Multer, Pino, Vitest/Supertest/Playwright, and development lint/format tools. Use one repository, an SPA and same-origin REST API, Docker Compose and private attachment delivery; start with existing design tokens/custom CSS. Verify and pin compatible versions; record measured or explicitly unavailable VPS capacity evidence, recovery-cost options, and performance targets for owner approval. No production deployment or infrastructure mutation is implied. Record unknown provider/domain/workloads and budget tradeoff. The user expects to maintain primarily through AI coding tools.

Planning ID: 1. Prerequisite decision/evidence ticket; obtain approval of unresolved choices before downstream implementation.

State boundaries: Zustand owns shared local UI state; TanStack Query owns server data; React Hook Form owns form state. Component-private state may use React hooks. Do not persist clinical drafts or sensitive state to browser storage.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Record the approved React/TypeScript, Express/TypeScript, PostgreSQL/Prisma and Docker/Nginx foundation and supporting dependency decisions.
- [ ] Verify mutually compatible stable versions and document exact version pins, service layout and test execution strategy before installation.
- [ ] Document VPS evidence or unavailable evidence, recovery costs/unknowns, budget tradeoffs and measurable performance targets; obtain owner acceptance of unresolved choices without deploying.
- [ ] Record reviewed decisions and evidence; explicitly identify unresolved gates and obtain the required owner decisions.

## Blocked by

None — can start immediately.
